searchText: Not sure if this is the right place to ask, but is there a nice tool to easily get the data needed by `ethereum_package`s `additional_preloaded_contracts` from a contract on a live chain? I guess manually fetching the storage slots is tricky, especially with maps (but I am not that familiar with the EVM...). Or maybe something that traces a contract creating transaction and gives me the contents of the storage slots? hmm im not sure, i haven't tried doing so in the past :/ maybe <@808969530608451584> has for some contract?
